## Connect with the right manufacturers

# Connect with the right manufacturers

Reduce time-to-contract by finding qualified manufacturers. Share your business case and connect
with suppliers directly.
* Get vetted information on products and manufacturers
* Make requests for quotations easily
* Connect with manufacturers directly
* Close best-price deals without any brokerage fees

Go to the marketplace

# How it works:

# from product discovery to closed deal

We assist you in discovering new products, matching with potential qualified manufacturers, and
making the deals happen.
1. 1. Discover new products Search for the high-potential products in the largest expert-curated CTD
   database. Narrow your search applying the industry-specific filter that helps sort products by
   GMP approvals, country of origin, dossier type, dossier status, and other valuable features.
2. 2. Get positive response from manufacturers Submit a request indicating your target market(s),
   annual purchase forecast, preferable deal type, and your specific remarks. Get feedback via
   email. Use our platform to track your inquiry progress.
3. 3. Connect with qualified manufacturers directly Upon a supplier confirming interest, we
   facilitate direct negotiations between you and the supplier, empowering you with control and
   transparency throughout the process. Importantly, there are no additional fees, and you finalise
   all deals directly with the suppliers.

## Simple Enrollment in 4 Steps

## How It Works.

Getting started is easy and takes minutes. Here’s what happens:

Prescription Hope provides access to **hundreds of FDA-approved** brand-name medications for a set
**$70.00 per month** per medication. There are **no other charges** for the medication. Our patient
advocates manage enrollment, coordination, and ongoing program requirements through patient
assistance programs.

Plus, if one prescription assistance option is unavailable, Prescription Hope keeps looking for
other potential ways to help patients save on their medications.

[Trustpilot][20]

### Account Setup

Create your **secure account**. This will be your medication management portal where you can track
orders and manage your prescriptions.

### Add Your Prescriptions

Tell us which medications you need. We work with over **1,500 FDA-approved brand-name medications**
from 180+ pharmaceutical manufacturers.

### Household Information

Provide basic household information **required by patient assistance programs** to verify
eligibility. This helps us determine which programs you qualify for.

### Payment Information

Add your credit card for identity verification. If approved, you’ll be charged $70 per month for
each medication. **If we cannot help you, you will not be charged.**

[Paperwork and documentation icon]

### Submit Online Enrollment Form

Getting started is **free and easy**! Simply complete the online enrollment form. This process
allows you to create an account for your secure patient portal and provide the information needed
for pre-qualification.

[Customer support verification icon]

### Receive Personalized Welcome Call

An Enrollment Specialist will reach out to you for a **personalized welcome call**. During this
conversation, we’ll discuss the medications we can assist you with, and you will only be charged if
we can help.

[Illustration of a prescription pill bottle]

### We Order Your Medication

Once we receive the **required paperwork** from you and your healthcare provider, your first order
will typically be delivered within 2 to 4 weeks. After that, we will manage your ongoing refills
month after month.

[Delivery route or shipment icon]

### You Receive Your Medication

Medications are delivered directly to your home or healthcare providers office. Our **dedicated
team** manages your account month after month, allowing you to focus on what matters most—your
health.

[ Get Started Today! ][21]

## We Handle Everything For You

Prescription Hope is a medication access service that helps you enroll in pharmaceutical patient
assistance programs. For a set monthly fee of $70 per medication, our team manages the entire
process:

14.5% mean weight reduction in Chinese adults with obesity. Furthermore, mazdutide received China
NMPA approval in 2025, making it the first approved GLP/glucagon dual agonist globally. Available in
10mg vial configuration as a comparative GLP peptide for sale alongside survodutide for
GLP-1/glucagon mechanism research.

### Retatrutide + Tirzepatide Combo — Triple + Dual Agonist Comparison

The [Retatrutide + Tirzepatide combination][34] pairs the most advanced GLP peptides for sale in a
single protocol. Specifically, retatrutide (GLP-1/GIP/glucagon triple agonist) produced 24.2% weight
reduction in Phase 2, while tirzepatide (GLP-1/GIP dual agonist) produced 22.5% in SURMOUNT-1.
Furthermore, combining the two compounds enables comparative mechanism research and additive vs
redundant effect studies. Read our detailed [retatrutide vs tirzepatide analysis][35] for the full
comparison framework.

## Beyond GLP Peptides for Sale: Full Research Peptide Catalog

While GLP peptides for sale represent our highest-volume product category, our catalog extends
across multiple research peptide mechanism classes. Specifically, researchers running combined
protocols or studying complementary mechanisms benefit from accessing tissue repair compounds,
mitochondrial peptides, cognitive research compounds, and reproductive endocrinology peptides
alongside the GLP-class compounds.

### Tissue Repair and Anti-Inflammatory Research Peptides

Tissue repair research extends beyond the GLP peptides for sale category into pentadecapeptide and
tripeptide compounds with documented angiogenesis and anti-inflammatory mechanisms. Specifically,
our catalog includes [BPC-157][36] (pentadecapeptide with VEGFR2-Akt-eNOS mechanism), [KPV][37]
(α-MSH C-terminal tripeptide with NF-κB inhibition per the Dalmasso 2008 Gut paper), [KLOW
blend][38] (four-peptide combination for multi-pathway tissue research), [ARA-290 (cibinetide)][39]
with FDA Orphan Drug designation for sarcoidosis SFN, and [LL-37][40] cathelicidin antimicrobial
peptide.

### Mitochondrial and Khavinson Bioregulator Research Peptides

Mitochondrial biology and bioregulator research compounds complement the GLP peptides for sale
catalog for metabolic and longevity research protocols. Specifically, our catalog includes
[MOTS-c][41] (16-amino-acid mitochondrial-derived peptide), [SS-31][42] (mitochondrial-targeted
antioxidant, [FDA][43] approval as FORZINITY September 2025), and the Khavinson bioregulator family
including [Pinealon][44], [Thymalin][45], and [Cortagen][46] for chromatin remodeling and gene
expression research.

### Cognitive and Nootropic Research Peptides

Cognitive research peptides target synaptogenesis and CNS receptor pharmacology for neuroscience
research applications. Specifically, our catalog includes [Dihexa][47] (HGF/c-Met activator with
10⁷-fold greater synaptogenic potency than BDNF per McCoy 2012 JPET), [PE-22-28][48] (TREK-1
potassium channel blocker), and [PTD-DBM][49] (Yonsei CXXC5/Wnt pathway research compound).
Furthermore, these nootropic research peptides serve different research questions than the GLP
peptides for sale, addressing synaptic plasticity and neurodegeneration rather than metabolic
outcomes.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.

medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming

billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now

[Read →][21]
[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Run open-source AI, privately.

We run open-source AI models for you in private, secure datacenters. We never train on your data,

[Read our GDPR-compliant privacy policy →][3]

## Broad support.

We run models from any supported open-source LLM architecture, including:
* Kimi K2.7 Code
* GLM 5.2
* MiniMax M3
* Qwen3.6 27B

[And many more][4]. If vLLM supports it, we do too.

## Simple pricing.

Subscribe for $30/month, and use models in our app — or in any of your favorite OpenAI-compatible
tools, like [Roo][5], [Cline][6], [Octofriend][7], and more.

Or use standard usage-based pricing and never pay for anything you don't use.

[See pricing →][8]

We built[Synbad][9], an open-source evaluation suite sourced from critical bugs encountered by
coding agents like Claude Code, Crush, OpenCode, and more.

COMPANY PROFILE

At TLC we specialize in the custom synthesis of complex organic compounds for use as reference
standards by the bio-medical and pharmaceutical industries around the world.
Download TLC Brochure
UNCOMPROMISED QUALITY
At TLC, quality is not just a commitment, it is ingrained in our culture. Our extensive COA, which
includes HPLC, NMR, MS, IR, EA, GC, Water Content, residual solvents and Assay, coupled with **ISO
17034** and **ISO 17025** accreditations, serves as a testament to our unwavering dedication to
delivering products that meet the highest standards of excellence in the industry.
EXTENSIVE INVENTORY
TLC currently offers over 24,000 certified reference standards from stock and we add approximately
2,000 new standards yearly. Our product line includes Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), drug
impurities and metabolite standards, as well as their stable isotope labelled analogues and amino
acid/peptide drug standards.

17034** and **ISO 17025** accreditations, serves as a testament to our unwavering dedication to
delivering products that meet the highest standards of excellence in the industry.
EXTENSIVE INVENTORY
TLC currently offers over 24,000 certified reference standards from stock and we add approximately
2,000 new standards yearly. Our product line includes Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), drug
impurities and metabolite standards, as well as their stable isotope labelled analogues and amino
acid/peptide drug standards.

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical

Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
